if.name: if
if.description: Conditional step - evaluates an expression and runs 'then' or 'else' sub-steps accordingly

params.description: Expression to evaluate as boolean (e.g. 'var.count > 3')

params.name: then
params.description: Steps to execute if the condition is true

params.name: else
params.description: Steps to execute if the condition is false

switch.name: switch
switch.description: Multi-branch step - evaluates an expression and matches against case values

params.name: on
params.description: Expression to evaluate (result compared against case values)

params.name: cases
params.description: List of {value: expr, steps: [...]} case objects

params.name: default
params.description: Steps to execute if no case matches

while.name: while
while.description: Loop step - repeatedly executes sub-steps while a condition is true

params.name: when
params.description: Expression evaluated before each iteration (e.g. 'var.i < len(var.targets)')

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum iteration count (safety cap, hard max 1000)

params.description: Steps to execute each iteration

return.description: Exit the current scope early. Inside a custom action, exits the action (caller continues). At the handler rule level, exits the rule's step list. Inside control flow (if/switch/while), propagates up to the nearest scope boundary.
